next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-1 must be defined as an alphanumeric data item such that its value can be a program-name."; 2023: "Identifier-1 shall be defined as an alphanumeric, national, or program-pointer data item.". 2023 extends identifier-1 of CALL to national and program-pointer data items, so it accepts programs that 1985 refused, where only alphanumeric items were allowed.
